ticket.subject: Invitation to speak at our webinar
ticket.body_text:
Good morning,

We are hosting a webinar on customer operations next month and would love someone from your team on the panel.

The session is 45 minutes and fully online. Past speakers came from about 30 software companies.

Would anyone be available?

Kind regards,
Leila
